section_summary.extract_value: This introduction describes a study examining the psychometric properties of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) in Malaysian women, addressing a gap in the literature regarding body image in non-Western cultures. The study aims to verify the unidimensionality of the BAS using confirmatory factor analysis and to examine ethnic differences in body appreciation between Malaysian Chinese and Malay women, the two major ethnic groups in the study site.
